scope: Local application and non-UI layer source; vendored UI/Utilities, generated output and tests excluded
exclusionReason: Temporary code-generation runs and review worktree copies are excluded from consumer rollout counts.

decisions.legacyInstanceModels: Retain the explicit-instance compatibility path: 115 calls remain in 7 local projects, including current mono_new/app-lc sources.
decisions.hideInstance: Review and migrate instance options to explicit DOM targets before upgrading consumers; many older apps include their own component/helper copies.
decisions.tableStorage: Assign stable existing storage keys where persistence is required; absence alone does not prove a defect.
decisions.consumerRuntime: Upgrade consumers to the tested Nuxt/Vue runtime before adopting the Vapor library; older Nuxt 3/4.2 apps have not been upgraded by this audit.
decisions.codeChanges: Consumer checkouts were audited read-only; no external application deployment or backend-dependent E2E is claimed.
